'''Eidgar Dheas''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and a member of the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. At the BBA outpost on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] he handled the bounty contract management.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
